turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Alex calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Jose Ermineskin?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. And is your mailing address still a same?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, same address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $1,647.30.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm not able to pay that right now. I split with my partner in Apr and moved out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm only bringing home about $2670 a month now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: set that up I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay 500 the 2nd.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $500.00 on October 2. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
